thread:
Lina (CS): Flag from today's onboarding review with ClearHarbor: three product pain points that could affect their renewal discussion next week.
Omar (Product): Please list them raw.
Lina (CS): 1) Embedding refresh delay after nightly reprocess (customer expects near-real-time). 2) No simple per-route billing toggle in Console (their finance team needs this). 3) Admin needs a per-route token dashboard instead of CSVs.
Sam (PM): Which are blockers vs nice-to-have?
Lina (CS): Embedding delay + billing toggle = potential blocker for renewal. Token dashboard = low-risk UX ask.
Jules (Eng): Any repro notes on the embedding issue?
Lina (CS): They repro by triggering re-index then running queries while index streaming; results show duplicates/stale vectors.
Omar (Product): Triage proposal: short-term UI indicator + debounce to prevent queries during reindex (low effort). Mid-term: atomic namespace swap for indexes (bigger). Billing toggle: feature-flag + Console control (small).
Sam (PM): Prioritize embed fix + billing toggle for immediate pipeline. Token dashboard to backlog.
notif-bot: Note created: https://redwood.internal/cs/4799991122 assigned to @Omar.
Lina (CS): I'll draft customer-facing note and propose demo slots after patch.
Jules (Eng): Estimates: UI indicator/debounce ~1-2d; atomic swap ~3-5w; billing toggle ~2-3d. I'll add tickets and tag eng-oncall if needed.
Omar (Product): Thanks. Please paste ticket IDs here once created.
Lina (CS): Draft message to ClearHarbor: "We're prioritizing the issues that impact your renewal: a UI status + debounce will be deployed within 10 business days; a per-route billing toggle will follow within two weeks. We'll schedule a short demo once the patch is live and keep you updated on the longer-term atomic swap plan."
Sam (PM): Good. Add prioritization criteria (impact, effort, cross-customer demand).
Lina (CS): Added and sending now.
Omar (Product): I'll open an RFC for the atomic swap and link this thread.
Jules (Eng): Will create engineering tickets today.
Lina (CS): Thanks all :thumbsup:
